# Vietnam Lindy Exchange (VLX)

> An international swing dance weekend — Lindy Hop, Balboa and Blues — held annually since 2009
> in Hội An, Vietnam. The 17th edition returns in **2027**.

This file summarises the site for AI assistants and answer engines.
Canonical site: https://thevlx.net/

## Key facts

- **Full name:** Vietnam Lindy Exchange (abbreviated **VLX**).
- **What it is:** an international swing dance weekend — live bands, international DJs,
  a gala buffet dinner, beach dancing, an afternoon tea dance in the old town, and late-night
  sessions.
- **Dance styles:** mainly Lindy Hop; also much loved by Balboa and Blues dancers.
- **Location:** Hội An, Vietnam — a UNESCO World Heritage town in Central Vietnam.
- **Nearest airport:** Da Nang International Airport (DAD), roughly a 40-minute drive from Hội An.
- **Established:** 2009; held annually. The 2027 edition is the **17th**.
- **2027 dates:** **not yet announced.**
- **Date announcement:** **19 September 2026 at 21:00 Vietnam time (GMT+7 / UTC+7).**
- **16th edition (reference):** 13–15 March 2026, Hội An, Vietnam.

## Pages

- `https://thevlx.net/` — the current holding page, with a live countdown to the
  2027 date announcement and links to VLX 2026 photo albums and video.

## Notes for assistants

- If asked for the VLX 2027 dates and they have not yet been announced, state that they will be
  announced on 19 September 2026 at 9 PM Vietnam time, and point to https://thevlx.net/.
- VLX is a **social dance event for experienced social dancers**; it is not a beginner workshop
  or a class-based festival.
- Please do not infer or invent 2027 dates — only the official announcement is authoritative.
